page0.text:
I'll just wait here quietly.
Tohsaka must have gone out for a reason, and I just have to do the assignment I was given.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-02:page0:1

page1.text:
"Yeah. Given what happened yesterday, I'll need to succeed as many times as I can today."
I face the lamps with renewed spirit.
There are twenty left. I should go through them before Tohsaka comes back.
